about_the_game:
Explore the world of Solateria as a little flame-born warrior, on a journey to search for the Primordial Flame, the last hope to save the world from the Shadow Plague.

Story

A small Flame Warrior who has lost their memories begins a journey to find the King—the only hope to save the world.

The land of the sun, Solateria, once flourished gloriously under the blessing of the Primordial Flame.

One day, the deadliest plague—the Shadow Plague—swept across the world, driving Solateria to the brink of collapse. To make matters worse, the Primordial Flame, the king who had always been their savior, vanished without a trace in the aftermath of the disaster.

Awaken as a little flame-born warrior with no memories, guided only by a voice calling you to find the lost king.

Continue your search for the lost king—and face the hidden truth that awaits at the end of your path.

Game Features

Stylish, Parry-Focused Combat

Read enemy patterns carefully and parry at just the right moment. Successfully parrying an enemy’s attack will reduce their stun points, allowing you to quickly break their guard and stagger them. In addition, by perfectly parrying certain attack patterns, you can trigger powerful Pyron Actions—choose one to turn the tide of battle in your favor.

Heat Core System

As a warrior of flame, the protagonist can unlock the "Heat Core," gaining access to a range of powerful abilities across five stages. With each unlocked stage, new skills become available to aid you in battle. Unleash the full power of the flame-born warrior and experience relentless, unstoppable combat.

Exploration Through Combat Skills

Your combat skills are not just for battle—they are essential for exploration as well. Combine various movement and combat abilities to reach seemingly inaccessible places. As you progress through the game, you'll unlock a range of skills, including double jump, aerial dash, rapid descent, wall-dash, Ash Blaster, Ash Break, and more.

Hand-Drawn World

Explore a vast world brought to life with beautiful hand-drawn graphics. Use your skills to uncover hidden secrets, create shortcuts, and carve new paths. As you venture deeper into the hidden corners of the world, you may even recover fragments of your lost memories.

short_description: Explore the world of Solateria as a young flame-born warrior, on a journey to search for the Primordial Flame, the last hope to save the world from the Shadow Plague. This parry-focused metroidvania features stylish, intense combat. Set in a ruined world, battle monstrous bosses and find the truth.
